description:
QB Mod Browser and Mod Manager - QBMBAMM

DOWNLOAD

Source code

Installation
unzip the archive and run the .exe
SmartScreen will warn you because the .exe is unsigned, press "More info" -> "Run anyway"
The .exe is built from public source code automatically via a github action
You can also build the exe yourself by downloading the source code and running build-and-run-server.bat

QBMBAMM provides a modern, all-in-one UI experience for Starsector modded gameplay.

Mod browsing Search, sorting of many kinds - popularity, age, game version, category, latest activity, etc
Automatic download/install Automatically install most mods straight from the forum
Mod managing Enable, disable, or remove mods in your mods folder
Automatic extract/install of archives in mods folder for externally sourced mods
Update checking for updates through the forum and VersionChecker data
Mod profiles Save and switch between different sets of mods
Favorites Quickly mark your favourite mods
Dependencies Display and quick downloading of installed mods' dependencies
Keyboard assisted browsing Quick paging and categorizing

As always, updating mods mid-campaign might break your save, check each mod to see if they say it's a breaking change or not.

Bug reporting: in-app bug button (opens a channel in the Unofficial Starsector Chat https://discord.gg/a8AWVcPCPr )
Discussion: this forum thread or that same discord channel that's opened when you click the bug button
Tested on windows, chrome

FAQ
Q: How does it differ from TriOS?
A: TriOS is primarily a good mod manager, I found myself still using the forum to browse and download mods. QBMBAMM is an all in one modern UI solution for the entire browse to install and manage stack
Q: How do I migrate?
A: It automatically scans your starsector mods folder, you don't really need to do anything

FEATURE SHOWCASE
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=474U_iIGYcI

aiDescription: Provides a modern, all-in-one interface for browsing, downloading, installing, and managing Starsector mods. Features include automatic downloads from the forum, update checking, mod profiles, and dependency management. It allows users to enable, disable, or remove mods and supports keyboard-assisted navigation.
